2610.02874.abstract_en: Scalable driving simulators typically execute vehicle commands using prescribed behavioral or kinematic rules, overlooking the physics of tire-road interfaces, thereby limiting their ability to capture how adverse road and environmental conditions alter vehicle execution and propagate through traffic. To address this limitation, we present SceneFactory-3D, a GPU-batched, physics-grounded multi-agent driving simulator. Vehicles execute acceleration and steering commands via suspension- and friction-limited forces evaluated at each wheel-contact point. Spatially varying friction, per-world 3D heightfields, gravity, and rigid contact consistently govern wheel motion and chassis collisions. Per-world terrain isolation and GPU batching enable SceneFactory-3D to run matched physical counterfactuals in parallel: traffic scenario setup and vehicle controllers remain fixed while only the road condition changes, enabling the resulting closed-loop effects to be evaluated across parallel worlds. To demonstrate the advantage of the SceneFactory-3D-enabled counterfactual evaluation, we conduct an empirical study on vehicle controllers' sensitivity to road conditions. We study three learned-policy families on 1,024 matched 12-vehicle worlds per condition, and two classical planners on a shared 32-world subset, across 21 friction and grade conditions. When friction drops from 1.0 to 0.18, the share of vehicles that clear the work zone safely falls by 6 to 90 percentage points across learned policies (18-19 for classical planners), and near-collision situations become more frequent for every learned policy. Code: https://github.com/SmallWorldLab/SceneFactory_3D
2610.02874.abstract_zh: 可扩展驾驶模拟器通常依照预设的行为或运动学规则执行车辆指令，忽略轮胎与道路界面的物理作用，因此难以刻画不利道路和环境条件如何改变车辆执行过程并在交通流中传播。为解决这一局限，我们提出 SceneFactory-3D，一个采用 GPU 批处理、以物理为基础的多智能体驾驶模拟器。车辆通过在每个车轮接触点计算、受悬架和摩擦限制的力来执行加速与转向指令。空间变化的摩擦、每个模拟世界各自的3D高度场、重力和刚体接触，共同决定车轮运动与车身碰撞。各世界独立的地形和 GPU 批处理，使 SceneFactory-3D 能够并行运行匹配的物理反事实实验：交通场景设置和车辆控制器保持固定，只改变道路条件，从而跨平行世界评估由此产生的闭环效应。为展示这种反事实评估的优势，我们实证研究车辆控制器对道路条件的敏感性。在每种条件下，对三类学习策略使用 1,024 个匹配的、各含 12 辆车的世界；在共享的 32 个世界子集上评估两种经典规划器；共覆盖 21 种摩擦与坡度条件。摩擦系数从 1.0 降至 0.18 时，各学习策略中安全通过施工区域的车辆比例下降 6 至 90 个百分点（经典规划器为 18 至 19 个百分点），且所有学习策略的近碰撞情况都更频繁。代码：https://github.com/SmallWorldLab/SceneFactory_3D

2610.02802.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to perform diverse manipulation tasks, but task success in existing rigid-body benchmarks does not indicate whether they preserve objects. We introduce ManiPhysicsZoo, which consolidates literature-supported material properties, 3D meshes, and supporting references into reusable object assets. Using these assets, a solver-based assessment computes grasp-specific damage thresholds from object geometry, material properties, and recorded grasp conditions and compares them with recorded contact forces to assess potential deformation and fracture. Building on these components, ManiPhysicsBench evaluates object preservation in LIBERO and SimplerEnv across three physics axes and three difficulty levels. Public VLA checkpoints show a substantial gap between task success and safe success, defined as task completion while preserving the object. Their gripper commands concentrate near full opening and closure, with largely similar aggregate distributions across objects, consistent with binary gripper supervision. We examine how object-specific continuous gripper labels change model behavior by retraining a VLA model. The retrained model shows more object-dependent gripping and higher safe success, but lower task success and limited generalization of object-preserving behavior.
2610.02802.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型旨在执行多种操作任务，但现有刚体基准中的任务成功，并不能说明它们能否保护物体。我们提出 ManiPhysicsZoo，将有文献支持的材料属性、3D网格及相应参考资料整合为可复用的物体资产。基于这些资产，求解器式评估依据物体几何、材料属性和记录的抓取条件，计算针对具体抓取的损伤阈值，并与记录的接触力比较，以评估潜在形变和断裂。在此基础上，ManiPhysicsBench 在 LIBERO 和 SimplerEnv 中沿三个物理维度、三个难度级别评估物体保护能力。公开 VLA 检查点的任务成功率与安全成功率存在显著差距；安全成功定义为完成任务且物体保持完好。它们的夹爪指令集中于几乎全开和全闭，且不同物体上的总体分布大体相似，这与二值夹爪监督一致。我们通过重新训练一个 VLA 模型，考察按物体区分的连续夹爪标签如何改变模型行为。重新训练的模型表现出更依赖物体的夹持方式和更高的安全成功率，但任务成功率更低，保护物体的行为泛化仍有限。

2610.02840.abstract_en: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.
2610.02840.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型联合学习预测世界动力学和机器人动作，使内部学到的世界动力学指导准确动作。现有方法通常用 RGB 帧或其潜在表示描述世界，并以末端执行器位姿或关节角预测动作，但往往难以捕捉灵巧操作所需的3D空间结构和接触几何。我们提出 Point World Action Model（PointWAM），一种3D世界动作模型：将世界分解为场景（环境）和手（执行者），在共享的时空坐标系中联合预测二者的3D点轨迹。这种显式且解耦的表示，无须针对任务选择物体或关键点，就能有效利用大规模人类示范视频预训练。给定彩色点云和语言指令，PointWAM 预测场景与手如何随时间在3D空间中共同演化，再将预测的手部运动重定向为机器人动作。人类视频预训练使 DexJoCo 平均成功率提高 56.9 个百分点；相较只预测手，场景轨迹监督额外提高 10.9 个百分点。两者结合后，PointWAM 在十项 DexJoCo 任务上比此前最优方法高 11.7 个百分点，并在真实机器人上优于强 VLA 基线。

2610.02343.abstract_en: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.
2610.02343.abstract_zh: 几何理解有助于内镜导航和机器人辅助，但学习可靠的内镜几何面临两个挑战：几何标注稀缺，以及相机运动与组织形变之间存在歧义。我们提出 SCOPE-4D，一种内镜4D几何基础模型，可在一次前向传播中从单目 RGB 视频联合预测相机参数、稠密几何和3D组织轨迹。我们的整理与标注流程构建了 SCOPE-5K，包含约 5,000 段真实与合成的胃肠内镜及腹腔镜视频。该集合提供丰富的几何监督，并纳入新采集的仿体和真实结肠镜评估集。在 SCOPE-5K 上进行几何监督微调，可学到改进相机与深度估计的内镜先验。Common--Residual Motion（CRM）进一步约束相对于组织共同运动的局部形变。结合几何监督后，CRM 和轨迹监督不仅相对单独的几何微调进一步改善相机与深度估计，也实现稠密3D组织跟踪。在公开和新采集的基准上的评估显示，该方法具有较强的域内与域外几何估计、更好的3D跟踪以及更稳定的长序列结肠重建。盲法用户研究进一步支持其在真实临床视频上的感知重建质量。这些结果共同说明，大规模内镜监督与运动约束有助于联合几何估计和组织跟踪。

2610.03473.abstract_en: We propose UniDynamics, a diffusion-based framework for future 4D dynamic scenes (RGB, depth, and optical flow) generation from a single event-RGB pair, without requiring long histories or control priors as in existing methods, while explicitly modeling future motion fields. The core idea is to leverage event streams to offer an alternative motion prior for single-RGB extrapolation, and to enforce geometric and motion constraints throughout generation via multimodal modeling. Specifically, we design an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to align and enhance event latents into diffusion-injectable conditioning features, providing robust initial motion priors and reliable texture/structure cues. We further introduce a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) embedded in the multi-scale U-Net, which decouples and adaptively interacts depth and flow while continuously feeding back constraints to appearance features, improving geometric-motion consistency for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent prediction. Experiments on VKitti2 and DSEC demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, producing high-quality, temporally coherent, and 4D-consistent future predictions, especially under challenging high-speed motion blur.
2610.03473.abstract_zh: 我们提出 UniDynamics，一种基于扩散的框架，可从单对事件数据与 RGB 图像生成未来4D动态场景（RGB、深度和光流）；与现有方法不同，它无需长历史或控制先验，同时显式建模未来运动场。核心思想是利用事件流为单张 RGB 图像的外推提供另一种运动先验，并通过多模态建模在整个生成过程中施加几何和运动约束。具体而言，我们设计 Event Latent Enhancement（ELE）模块，将事件潜变量对齐并增强为可注入扩散模型的条件特征，提供稳健的初始运动先验以及可靠的纹理和结构线索。我们还在多尺度 U-Net 中引入 Perceptual Dynamics Space（PDS），使深度与光流解耦并自适应交互，同时持续向外观特征反馈约束，从而提高几何与运动的一致性，得到物理上合理且时空连贯的预测。在 VKitti2 和 DSEC 上的实验显示，方法达到当前最优表现，生成高质量、时间连贯、4D一致的未来预测，尤其在具有挑战性的高速运动模糊情况下如此。

2610.03374.abstract_en: Embodied world models enable scalable simulation of embodied interactions for robot learning. However, existing models are prone to Model Laziness, as they focus on visual fidelity at the expense of physical reasoning and lack process-level supervision over the temporal dynamics of manipulated objects. In this work, we propose EVEWorld, a physical evolution-supervision framework for physically consistent target evolution. EVEWorld consists of two components: Instance-Guided Restoration (IGR) and Temporal Instance Alignment (TIA). First, IGR promotes instance consistency through restoration supervision. Second, TIA promotes cross-frame consistency by aligning target instances across adjacent frames. We further introduce the Model Laziness Rate (MLR), a metric that measures persistent violations of instance consistency in generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on DreamGenBench, EWMBench, and PBench demonstrate the effectiveness of EVEWorld, notably achieving an 87.5% reduction in MLR compared with GigaWorld-0. On the WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 leaderboard, our model ranks 6th in JEPA Similarity and 17th overall, which further validates the performance of our evolution supervision strategy.
2610.03374.abstract_zh: 具身世界模型能够为机器人学习大规模模拟具身交互。然而，现有模型容易出现“模型惰性”：重视视觉逼真度而牺牲物理推理，并缺少对被操作物体时序动力学的过程级监督。我们提出 EVEWorld，一个用于实现物理一致目标演化的物理演化监督框架。EVEWorld 包含两个组件：Instance-Guided Restoration（IGR）和 Temporal Instance Alignment（TIA）。首先，IGR 通过恢复监督促进实例一致性；其次，TIA 通过对齐相邻帧中的目标实例促进跨帧一致性。我们还提出 Model Laziness Rate（MLR），衡量生成轨迹中实例一致性持续违规的比例。在 DreamGenBench、EWMBench 和 PBench 上的大量实验表明 EVEWorld 有效；尤其与 GigaWorld-0 相比，MLR 降低 87.5%。在 WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 排行榜上，模型的 JEPA Similarity 排第 6、总体排第 17，进一步验证演化监督策略的表现。

2610.03453.abstract_en: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned "convex-slot" tokens emit the halfplane parameters of $K$ convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ${\sim}0.5$s per image. On $227$ held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running $6$-$37\times$ faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes "load" everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a $20$-object cluttered scene in $11$s versus $328$s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ($85$ vs. $90$ of $100$ trials).
2610.03453.abstract_zh: 物理模拟器和运动规划器需要凸的碰撞几何，但图像到3D的生成模型输出的是密集且常常非流形的视觉网格。如今连接两者需要先重建再分解的缓慢且脆弱流程，涉及修复、简化和近似凸分解。我们提出 I2CD，直接从单张 RGB 图像预测凸分解。I2CD 不训练新的图像到3D模型，而是冻结预训练的 Hunyuan3D-2 图像条件扩散 Transformer 与形状解码器，只训练一个轻量交叉注意力头（38M（3,800 万）参数，训练少于 10 GPU 小时）；其学到的“凸槽位” token 输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数。输出紧凑且按构造即为凸形，无须任何后处理即可载入物理引擎，每张图像约需 0.5 秒。在 227 个留出的 OmniObject3D 和 Google Scanned Objects 实例上，I2CD 在八种先重建再分解流程中达到最高的体积 IoU，端到端速度快 6 至 37 倍。在 MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis 和 Isaac Sim 的跨模拟器研究中，每个引擎都直接使用 I2CD 输出的几何；原始生成网格虽在各引擎中都能“载入”，但多数情况下碰撞形状会被悄悄替换，或需要每个物体数秒至数分钟的预处理。在实体 xArm7 上，I2CD 为包含 20 个物体的杂乱场景生成可供规划的几何需 11 秒，而最强基线需 328 秒；二者的抓取放置执行成功次数分别为 100 次中的 85 次和 90 次，表现接近。

2610.02691.abstract_en: Interactive world simulators can provide scalable environments for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation by predicting action consequences while reducing reliance on repeated physical rollouts. To serve these applications, they must generate future image sequences that respond faithfully to robot actions and preserve the dynamics of robot-object interactions over long horizons. However, existing world models typically predict the entire next latent state and often fail to capture subtle changes induced by robot actions. Such omissions can produce physically implausible outcomes, including object interpenetration and excessive deformation. To address this limitation, we propose DeltaWorld, a physically consistent interactive world simulator for robotic manipulation. Our method introduces the Delta Latent Transition Model (Delta-LTM), which predicts action-induced latent feature changes and adds them to the current latent state to obtain the next state, rather than predicting the next latent state directly. To mitigate object interpenetration and excessive deformation in predicted future frames, Interaction-aware Latent Alignment is introduced to construct counterfactual interaction regions and supervise interaction-related latent changes. DeltaWorld is evaluated on the IWS manipulation benchmark and a self-collected cross-robot dataset covering multiple robot embodiments and manipulation tasks. On the cross-robot dataset, DeltaWorld reduces FVD by 46.6% and LPIPS by 31.1% relative to the IWS baseline. These results highlight the potential of DeltaWorld for long-horizon action-conditioned video prediction in robotic manipulation.
2610.02691.abstract_zh: 交互式世界模拟器通过预测动作后果、减少反复进行实体交互的依赖，可为机器人规划、策略训练和评估提供可扩展环境。要服务这些用途，它们必须生成忠实响应机器人动作、并能在长时域保持机器人与物体交互动力学的未来图像序列。然而，现有世界模型通常预测整个下一潜在状态，往往遗漏机器人动作造成的细微变化，进而产生物体互穿、过度形变等物理上不合理的结果。为此，我们提出用于机器人操作的物理一致交互式世界模拟器 DeltaWorld。其 Delta Latent Transition Model（Delta-LTM）预测动作引起的潜在特征增量，并将其加到当前潜在状态得到下一状态，而非直接预测下一潜在状态。为了减轻预测未来帧中的物体互穿和过度形变，我们引入 Interaction-aware Latent Alignment，构建反事实交互区域并监督与交互有关的潜在变化。在 IWS 操作基准和自采集的跨机器人数据集上评估 DeltaWorld，后者涵盖多种机器人形态和操作任务。在跨机器人数据集上，相对 IWS 基线，DeltaWorld 的 FVD 降低 46.6%，LPIPS 降低 31.1%。结果显示该方法用于机器人操作中长时域动作条件视频预测的潜力。

2610.02566.abstract_en: Many physical and biological systems -foams, membranes, elastic shells, or tissue sheets- can be mathematically described as 2D surfaces. These surfaces can host complex dynamics, like reaction-diffusion systems, and undergo drastic deformations. Here, we present triangulax, an open-source Python library for simulations and geometry processing that discretizes surfaces using triangular meshes available at https://github.com/nikolas-claussen/triangulax. It combines two features. First, discrete differential geometry provides coordinate-free discretization, which allows simulating strongly deforming surfaces. Second, the library is built on the machine-learning framework JAX, so mesh-based energies and entire simulations can be differentiated automatically (including simulations with stochastic forces or topological modifications). This simplifies multi-physics simulations by computing forces automatically and allows fitting model parameters to experimental data or design objectives. We implement an algorithm to preserve mesh quality in strongly deforming surfaces and apply it to a model of membrane mechanics coupled to an on-membrane concentration field. We validate our approach against exact solutions and existing software, and demonstrate triangulax across a range of problems, including membrane mechanics, vertex models, and inverse design of a shape-morphing elastomer sheet.
2610.02566.abstract_zh: 许多物理与生物系统，例如泡沫、薄膜、弹性壳和组织薄片，可以在数学上描述为2D曲面。这些曲面能够承载反应—扩散系统等复杂动力学，并发生剧烈形变。我们提出 triangulax，一个用于模拟与几何处理的开源 Python 库，以三角网格离散曲面，地址为 https://github.com/nikolas-claussen/triangulax。它结合了两项特性。第一，离散微分几何提供不依赖坐标的离散化，使强形变曲面的模拟成为可能。第二，该库建立在机器学习框架 JAX 上，因此可对基于网格的能量及整个模拟过程自动求导，包括含随机力或拓扑修改的模拟。这通过自动计算力简化了多物理模拟，也使模型参数能够拟合实验数据或设计目标。我们实现了一个在强形变曲面上保持网格质量的算法，并将其用于膜力学与膜上浓度场耦合的模型。我们用精确解和现有软件验证方法，并展示 triangulax 在膜力学、顶点模型以及形变弹性片逆向设计等问题上的应用。

2610.02825.abstract_en: Road geometry (e.g., crests, sags, and speed humps) and surface conditions (e.g., wet or icy pavement) affect how vehicles move, what drivers and onboard cameras observe, and how much clearance remains between vehicles. Editing these properties in a driving scene therefore requires corresponding changes in vehicle motion. Capturing these differences in a driving video requires a road edit to propagate to vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and the clearance between vehicles. We present TerrainForge, a framework for generating road geometry-focused counterfactuals from reconstructed multi-vehicle driving episodes. A unified road model connects scene deformation with four-wheel vehicle dynamics, allowing crests, sags, speed humps, and friction changes to propagate through vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and inter-vehicle clearance. Vehicle dynamics are evaluated against CarSim, and prescribed road geometry is verified in reconstructed Waymo scenes. Across 18 episodes, leaving surrounding vehicles on their recorded trajectories instead of recomputing their responses produces median peak differences in predicted ego-lead distance of 1.52 m for crests and 1.41 m for sags. We further simulate the ego response to 15,758 road edits across 983 braking episodes, pairing each edit with its safety outcomes relative to an unedited replay. These pairs train a first-stage screening surrogate that takes the original driving context and candidate road-edit parameters as input and predicts the resulting change in the ego's terminal gap. On held-out scenes, this prediction achieves 22-40% lower mean absolute error than predicting no change, so candidates can be screened cheaply before the full multi-vehicle rollout.
2610.02825.abstract_zh: 道路几何（如凸坡、凹坡和减速丘）及路面条件（如湿滑或结冰）会影响车辆如何运动、驾驶员与车载摄像头看到什么，以及车辆之间剩余多少间距。因此，在驾驶场景中编辑这些属性，必须相应改变车辆运动。要在驾驶视频中呈现这些差异，道路编辑需要传导至车辆运动、相机视角和车间距离。我们提出 TerrainForge，一种从重建的多车驾驶片段生成以道路几何为重点的反事实场景的框架。统一的道路模型将场景形变与四轮车辆动力学联系起来，使凸坡、凹坡、减速丘和摩擦变化传导到车辆运动、相机视角及车间距离。车辆动力学以 CarSim 为参照评估；指定的道路几何在重建的 Waymo 场景中得到核验。在 18 段驾驶片段中，若让周围车辆沿记录轨迹行驶，而不重新计算它们的响应，预测的自车与前车距离峰值差异的中位数在凸坡和凹坡情形下分别达到 1.52 米和 1.41 米。我们还在 983 段制动片段中模拟自车对 15,758 次道路编辑的响应，将每次编辑与未编辑回放相比的安全结果配对。这些配对数据训练了第一阶段筛选代理模型：它以原始驾驶情境和候选道路编辑参数为输入，预测自车终点间距的变化。在留出场景上，相比预测“没有变化”，其平均绝对误差降低 22% 至 40%，因此可在完整多车推演之前廉价筛选候选编辑。

2610.03516.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.
2610.03516.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）通过预测观测和动作如何随时间演化，推动了机器人控制的发展。尽管如此，基于 RGB 和动作的未来预测并未显式处理机器人操作所需的空间理解。现有尝试往往通过专门的头或分支加入有限的空间预测任务，使空间监督范围和模型架构都较为割裂。我们提出 XGenAct：通过确定性编解码器，把 RGB 观测、机器人动作、公制深度、表面法线和功能角色分割都表示为 RGB 视频的世界动作模型。通过在训练中采样感知和动作任务，XGenAct 只用一个视频扩散 Transformer 和一个目标来学习这些空间中的时间预测，而不需要针对模态的学习头。在留出的 RLBench 任务上，结构化感知训练相对仅用 RGB 的训练提高了平均闭环成功率；在五任务外部比较中，XGenAct 的成功率达到 52%，而受评最强基线为 26%。相对于先生成 RGB、再应用冻结感知专家的受评流程，它对未来深度和分割的预测也更准确。

2610.03691.abstract_en: We present FlowHMR, a framework for recovering physically plausible global 3D human motion from monocular video. Previous learning-based methods typically regress human motion directly from video and train the network with geometric supervision. However, recovering human motion from monocular video is inherently ambiguous in depth, and direct regression tends to collapse toward an averaged solution. Moreover, the recovered motions are not guaranteed to be physically plausible, so physics-based tracking of them often fails. To address these challenges, we formulate video motion capture as a video-conditioned motion generation problem and first pretrain a flow matching model for this task. Given an input video, the pretrained model generates diverse motion candidates, but not all of them are faithful to the video or physically trackable. We therefore post-train the model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with two rewards. A fidelity reward encourages consistency with the input video. A tracking reward favors motions that a physics-based controller can track successfully. Together, these rewards shift the model's output preference, so the post-trained model stays faithful to the input video while producing more physically plausible motion. We further introduce Wild-4K, a large and diverse dataset of about 4K internet videos, for evaluating human motion recovery in the wild. Qualitative and quantitative experiments on Wild-4K show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall motion fidelity and achieves a physical tracking success rate of 82.47%, compared with 62.82% for the strongest baseline, GVHMR.
2610.03691.abstract_zh: 我们提出 FlowHMR，一个从单目视频恢复物理上合理的全局3D人体运动的框架。以往基于学习的方法通常从视频直接回归人体运动，并用几何监督训练网络。然而，从单目视频恢复人体运动本身存在深度歧义，直接回归容易坍缩到平均解。此外，恢复的运动不保证物理合理，因此基于物理的跟踪常会失败。为解决这些挑战，我们将视频动作捕捉表述为视频条件运动生成问题，首先为该任务预训练一个流匹配模型。给定输入视频，预训练模型生成多样的运动候选，但并非所有候选都忠实于视频或能被物理跟踪。因此，我们使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）和两种奖励对模型后训练：保真奖励鼓励与输入视频一致；跟踪奖励偏向物理控制器能够成功跟踪的运动。两种奖励共同改变模型的输出偏好，使后训练模型在忠实于输入视频的同时产生更合理的物理运动。我们还提出 Wild-4K，一个包含约 4,000 段多样互联网视频的大型数据集，用于评估自然场景中的人体运动恢复。在 Wild-4K 上的定性和定量实验显示，方法在整体运动保真度上优于现有最优方法，物理跟踪成功率为 82.47%，而最强基线 GVHMR 为 62.82%。

2610.03715.abstract_en: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench
2610.03715.abstract_zh: 我们提出 4DCodeBench，一个通过代码生成评估4D逆图形能力的基准：智能体要把视频中的动态场景重建为可执行的图形程序。为此，智能体必须将视觉观测转化为场景结构与动力学的紧凑表示，并实现物理模拟等抽象来复现复杂行为。为评估这一能力，我们整理了一组真实世界视频，并构建覆盖形变、流体流动和断裂等不同物理现象的合成场景。对前沿模型的大范围基准测试发现，较强的静态重建能力尚未转化为可靠的复杂动力学重建能力。4DCodeBench 为跟踪智能体通过代码理解世界动力学的进展提供了试验平台。基准地址：https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench

2610.02274.abstract_en: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis. Shared asset services providerigid and articulated objects, including structure-grounded part and jointgeneration with ISArt. Scene generation supports two complementary routes:Unravel reconstructs editable scenes from images, while SimForge buildssingle-room and multi-room environments from text. A graph-native harnesscoordinates construction, validation, andbounded repair, routing failures to the responsible module while retainingunaffected scene state. PolicyForge binds validated worlds to tasks and robotembodiments to produce replayable demonstrations. Evaluations cover assetgeometry, scene quality, and downstream policy learning. On MuJoCo-basedLIBERO-Plus, co-training with Isaac Sim demonstrations improves the overallsuccess rate of a World-Action Model (WAM) from $77.17\%$ to $89.43\%$. Goal and spatialsuccess improve by $31.66$ and $6.25$ percentage points, respectively.These results support the utility of the generated data for cross-simulatorpolicy training, with more limited gains on long-horizon tasks.
2610.02274.abstract_zh: 生成有用的机器人训练数据，所需的不只是视觉上可信的场景：物体必须支持交互，摆放必须在物理上有效，任务必须能够重复执行。我们提出 Awomo-SimDataEngine，一个将资产与场景生成连接到机器人示范合成的智能体系统。共享资产服务提供刚体和关节物体，其中包括通过 ISArt 基于结构生成部件与关节。场景生成支持两条互补路线：Unravel 从图像重建可编辑场景，SimForge 从文本构建单房间和多房间环境。图结构原生的调度框架协调构建、验证和有界修复，将失败交还负责模块，同时保留未受影响的场景状态。PolicyForge 将验证过的世界与任务及机器人形态绑定，生成可重放示范。评估覆盖资产几何、场景质量和下游策略学习。在基于 MuJoCo 的 LIBERO-Plus 上，加入 Isaac Sim 示范共同训练，使世界动作模型（WAM）的总体成功率从 77.17% 提高到 89.43%；目标任务和空间任务的成功率分别提高 31.66 和 6.25 个百分点。这些结果支持生成数据用于跨模拟器策略训练的效用，但在长时域任务上的收益较有限。

2610.02398.abstract_en: A robot demonstration records two things in the same frames: what happened to the objects, and how one particular arm made it happen. We condition on the first. A demonstration is compiled into an effect program: the 3D keypoint trajectories of the objects that moved, two points marking where each was held, and the configuration the scene ends in, with the demonstrator removed. PEWAM, a 71.5M-parameter world-action model, generates effect, robot execution, action and terminal state as four streams with independent flow-matching times, so clamping a program and sampling the execution turns inference into programming, re-solved closed loop from the live scene. On held-out LIBERO-Goal tasks, one demonstration's program completes 40 of 90 episodes, where the same backbone given a goal image or language, and published demonstration-conditioned methods, complete at most 19; on three of Meta-World's held-out classes it exceeds the best published results, though not on the five-class mean. Because a program is a set of coordinates, a person can edit it: the placement follows a shifted terminal state and the grasp turns with rotated contact points. The same program runs on four robot arms without retraining, and after a push, re-solving completes 23 of 60 episodes where replaying the demonstration completes 6. On a Franka arm, fine-tuned on real demonstrations of other tasks, programs compiled from single human videos complete 36 of 40 trials, against 22 for the same backbone conditioned on the video's last frame as a goal image.
2610.02398.abstract_zh: 一段机器人示范在同一组画面中记录了两件事：物体发生了什么，以及某一只特定机械臂如何使它发生。我们以第一件事为条件。示范被编译成效果程序：发生运动的物体的3D关键点轨迹、标记各物体被握持位置的两个点，以及场景最终构型，而示范者被移除。PEWAM 是一个具有 71.5M（7,150 万）参数的世界动作模型，它以四个流生成效果、机器人执行、动作和终止状态，每个流有独立的流匹配时间。因此，固定程序并采样执行便将推理转化为编程，并能依据实时场景在闭环中重新求解。在留出的 LIBERO-Goal 任务上，单段示范的程序完成 90 次实验中的 40 次；相同骨干以目标图像或语言为条件，以及已发表的示范条件方法，最多完成 19 次。在 Meta-World 的五个留出类别中，它在三个类别超过已发表的最佳结果，但在五类平均值上没有超过。由于程序是一组坐标，人可以编辑它：移动终止状态会移动放置位置，旋转接触点会改变抓取。相同程序无需重训练即可在四种机械臂上运行；受一次推撞后，重新求解完成 60 次中的 23 次，而重放示范仅完成 6 次。在 Franka 机械臂上，模型用其他任务的真实示范微调后，从单段人类视频编译的程序完成 40 次中的 36 次；相同骨干以该视频最后一帧作为目标图像时完成 22 次。

2610.03363.abstract_en: Neural surrogate models for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) on unstructured 3D geometries are often limited by poor generalization and the high cost of generating large-scale training datasets. Consequently, pre-training on massive datasets of related PDE dynamics has emerged as a critical alternative to enhance the robustness and scalability of these models. However, this strategy is neither compute- nor data-efficient, as it relies on massive pre-computed data that is very costly to generate. In this work, we introduce a disk-data-free pre-training framework tailored to both steady-state and transient regimes. For steady-state problems, we propose a geometry-driven strategy that leverages intrinsic shape descriptors to learn representations of complex 3D domains. For transient problems, we introduce a physics-driven approach based on online generation of synthetic PDE data, enabling scalable pre-training without reliance on expensive datasets. Across multiple experiments, our approach achieves faster convergence, greater data efficiency, and higher accuracy during fine-tuning, particularly under realistic low-data regimes. This methodology provides a practical pathway toward data-efficient neural emulators for large-scale simulations.
2610.03363.abstract_zh: 非结构化3D几何上的偏微分方程（PDE）神经代理模型，常受泛化较差和生成大规模训练数据成本高昂的限制。因此，在大量相关 PDE 动力学数据上预训练，成为提高模型稳健性和可扩展性的重要替代方案。然而，这一策略在算力和数据方面都不高效，因为它依赖生成成本很高的大量预计算数据。我们提出一种面向稳态和瞬态情形、无需磁盘预存数据的预训练框架。对于稳态问题，我们提出几何驱动策略，利用内在形状描述符学习复杂3D区域的表示。对于瞬态问题，我们提出基于在线生成合成 PDE 数据的物理驱动方法，使可扩展预训练不依赖昂贵数据集。多项实验表明，方法在微调时收敛更快、数据效率更高、精度更好，尤其是在现实的少数据情形下。该方法为大型模拟构建数据高效的神经仿真代理提供了一条实用路径。

2610.03154.abstract_en: Video generation models produce strikingly realistic sequences and are increasingly proposed as world models, yet recent benchmarks reveal pronounced deficits in their physical reasoning. This raises the question of whether these models internalize physical principles or merely reproduce familiar motion patterns. We address this by probing internal representations of video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for simulator-derived ground-truth physical quantities spanning kinematic motion and rigid-body dynamics under gravity and contact. We find that these quantities are linearly decodable with high accuracy early in the denoising process, substantially outperforming a baseline decoded directly from the model's own noised latents, indicating that the relevant physical information is actively constructed during denoising rather than already present in the input. Additionally, we show that activations at on-object tokens carry the relevant physical information and that quantities defined over multiple frames are readable from single latent frames. Hence, information is sharply localized within the token sequence and is computed globally but stored locally. The probes further show partial extrapolation, transferring to scene variations and object configurations outside their training regime, so what they read is not simply a correlate of the scenes they were fit on. When fitted directly in the full-resolution activation space, the probing directions can serve as steering vectors to change the model's output.
2610.03154.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型能产生十分逼真的序列，并日益被提议作为世界模型，但近期基准揭示其物理推理存在明显不足。这引出一个问题：模型是否内化了物理原理，还是仅重现熟悉的运动模式。我们通过探测视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）的内部表示来研究这一问题，目标是从模拟器获得的物理量真值，涵盖重力与接触条件下的运动学运动和刚体动力学。我们发现，在去噪早期，这些量便能以较高精度线性解码，显著优于直接从模型自身带噪潜变量解码的基线。这说明相关物理信息是在去噪过程中主动构建的，而非输入中已存在。此外，我们表明位于物体上的 token 激活包含相关物理信息，并且跨多帧定义的量可从单帧潜变量读出。因此，信息在 token 序列中高度局部化：通过全局计算，却储存在局部。探针还显示部分外推能力，可迁移到训练范围之外的场景变化与物体构型，因此读出的内容并非仅仅与拟合场景相关。若直接在全分辨率激活空间拟合，探测方向还能作为引导向量来改变模型输出。

2610.02580.abstract_en: Physical AI Smart Spaces is, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark to simultaneously provide large-scale, multi-class, and multi-camera 3D perception data for indoor smart spaces. It contains over 280 hours of synchronized 1080p footage captured by nearly 1,800 cameras in warehouses, hospitals, retail venues, and similar settings, together with automatic annotations for multi-camera identities, 2D bounding boxes, 3D bounding boxes, camera calibration, and depth where available. The benchmark spans Isaac Sim synthetic generation, Cosmos Transfer appearance augmentation, and real-world Sim2Real evaluation. For the real-world target, we include two warehouse deployments with time-synchronized streams, automatic VGGT-based calibration, and a 3D labeling interface that projects world-frame 3D boxes into each view for cross-camera verification. We describe the dataset scope, annotation and calibration schema, generation workflow, benchmark protocols, and official evaluation system, which standardizes submission format, and leaderboard reporting. A central contribution is a 3D instantiation of Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), extending the usual 2D box-based tracking evaluation to 3D locations and 3D boxes. We further report empirical baselines from the AI City Challenge leaderboards, showing how methods evolve from person-only 3D location tracking to multi-class 3D box tracking under realistic smart-space constraints. The release is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces.
2610.02580.abstract_zh: 据我们所知，Physical AI Smart Spaces 是首个同时为室内智能空间提供大规模、多类别、多摄像头3D感知数据的基准。它包含在仓库、医院、零售场所等环境中由近 1,800 台摄像头拍摄的超过 280 小时同步 1080p 视频，并提供多摄像头身份、2D边界框、3D边界框、相机标定，以及可用时的深度等自动标注。基准覆盖 Isaac Sim 合成生成、Cosmos Transfer 外观增强和真实世界 Sim2Real 评估。对于真实目标域，我们纳入两个仓库部署，具有时间同步的视频流、基于 VGGT 的自动标定，以及将世界坐标系3D框投影到各视角以供跨摄像头核验的3D标注界面。我们描述数据集范围、标注与标定规范、生成流程、基准协议，以及标准化提交格式和排行榜报告的官方评估系统。核心贡献是 Higher Order Tracking Accuracy（HOTA）的3D版本，把通常基于2D框的跟踪评估扩展至3D位置和3D框。我们还报告 AI City Challenge 排行榜的实证基线，展示在真实智能空间约束下，方法如何从仅追踪人的3D位置发展到多类别3D框追踪。发布地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces。

2610.02697.abstract_en: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adopt streaming Video-LLM policies that map egocentric RGB observations and instructions directly to low-level actions. Yet these policies inherit weak 3D geometric priors from 2D pretraining. Existing geometry-aware extensions charge a persistent inference-time price: depth sensors, 3D encoders, or per-step perception tool calls. We propose GeoScaffold, a geometric supervision framework that pays this price once, at training time, by internalizing geometry into the policy itself. It first learns a compact depth tokenizer on depth maps from the training trajectories and freezes it. It then fine-tunes the policy with a handful of learnable geometry query tokens, training their hidden states to reconstruct navigation-critical geometry such as depth, connectivity, and traversability. This supervision turns the query states into compact geometric latents for action decoding, and through the shared weights also internalizes geometry into the backbone's own representations. Like a scaffold, the tokenizer, target generators, and reconstruction heads are discarded after training, leaving the backbone and action interface unchanged. Extensive experiments show that GeoScaffold consistently outperforms leading vision-only navigators on continuous VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight edge deployment of spatially aware embodied navigation models.
2610.02697.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉语言导航（VLN）系统越来越多采用流式 Video-LLM 策略，将第一人称 RGB 观测和指令直接映射为低层动作。然而，这些策略从2D预训练继承的3D几何先验较弱。现有几何感知扩展在推理时持续付出代价：需要深度传感器、3D编码器，或每一步调用感知工具。我们提出 GeoScaffold，一种几何监督框架，只在训练时支付一次成本，将几何知识内化到策略本身。它首先在训练轨迹的深度图上学习紧凑的深度 tokenizer 并将其冻结，随后用少量可学习的几何查询 token 微调策略，训练它们的隐藏状态重建对导航关键的几何信息，如深度、连通性和可通行性。这种监督将查询状态转化为用于动作解码的紧凑几何潜变量，并通过共享权重把几何信息内化进骨干表示。如同脚手架，tokenizer、目标生成器和重建头在训练后被移除，留下不变的骨干与动作接口。大量实验表明，GeoScaffold 在连续 VLN 基准上持续优于领先的纯视觉导航器，为具空间意识的具身导航模型在边缘设备上的轻量部署提供实用范式。

2610.03015.abstract_en: Accurate 3D detection is essential for mobile embodied agents, while Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer transferable visual and geometric priors. Yet existing VFM-based 3D detectors rely on narrow-view monocular images or discrete perspective views, limiting coherent surround perception; equirectangular projection (ERP) instead encodes a continuous 360 scene in a single image. Direct transfer remains difficult because ERP organizes geometry and visual information differently, making object-relevant cues hard to model, localize, and preserve. We propose OmniAct3D, a framework that adapts perspective-trained VFM detectors to ERP while preserving transferable VFM priors. To resolve geometric mismatch, the ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter (ERGA-Ray) models spherical viewing rays and periodic spatial structure. To localize evidence in scene-wide context, the Visual-Action Reasoning Chain (VARC) grounds each hypothesis in relevant panoramic evidence and converts it into a structured geometric action. To recover local cues lost under fixed token budgets, the Appearance-Guided Heading Expert (AGHE) re-encodes object regions at higher resolution for heading estimation. Experiments show that OmniAct3D improves over the previous best 3D detector by 2.96 NDS points on Spheriverse and over the unadapted VFM baseline by 24.87 mAP points on PanoMMOcc. With target-specific geometry adaptation, VARC retains 95--98% of the same-configuration mAP, indicating reusable object-level 3D reasoning across sensing configurations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/OmniAct3D.
2610.03015.abstract_zh: 准确的3D检测对移动具身智能体至关重要，而视觉基础模型（VFM）提供可迁移的视觉与几何先验。然而，现有基于 VFM 的3D检测器依赖窄视角单目图像或离散透视视图，限制了连贯的环视感知；等距柱状投影（ERP）则用一张图编码连续的 360 度场景。直接迁移仍很困难，因为 ERP 组织几何和视觉信息的方式不同，使与物体有关的线索难以建模、定位和保留。我们提出 OmniAct3D，在保留可迁移 VFM 先验的同时，将透视视图训练的 VFM 检测器适配到 ERP。为解决几何不匹配，ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter（ERGA-Ray）建模球面视线和周期性空间结构。为在全场景上下文中定位证据，Visual-Action Reasoning Chain（VARC）将每个假设关联到相关全景证据，并转换为结构化几何动作。为恢复固定 token 预算下丢失的局部线索，Appearance-Guided Heading Expert（AGHE）以更高分辨率重新编码物体区域用于朝向估计。实验表明，OmniAct3D 在 Spheriverse 上比此前最佳3D检测器高 2.96 个 NDS 点，在 PanoMMOcc 上比未适配 VFM 基线高 24.87 个 mAP 点。经过针对目标的几何适配，VARC 保留相同配置下 95% 至 98% 的 mAP，表明物体级3D推理可以跨传感配置复用。源代码将发布于 https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/OmniAct3D。

2610.03308.abstract_en: We reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scene meshes from posed multi-view images without per-scene optimization, across scales ranging from single objects to large outdoor scenes. Per-scene optimization methods lack the learned 3D prior needed when observations are sparse or surfaces are glossy or transparent. Existing generative methods leverage such priors to complete geometry in sparsely observed regions, but typically operate at a fixed resolution over a limited spatial extent, trading spatial coverage against detail. Reconstructing a large scene therefore often requires partitioning it into independently processed overlapping local regions, making it difficult to maintain global geometric consistency. To address these issues, we propose T3lescope, which applies a single fixed-resolution generator across scene scales in an inference-time coarse-to-fine cascade. A coarse level establishes the scene layout, and finer levels perturb and denoise geometry inherited from the coarser level within progressively finer spatial cells to recover surface detail. The model is trained on individual cells at multiple scales and shares its weights across all levels, so no hierarchy is fixed during training, and the number of levels, cell scales, and cell locations are determined at inference time. On indoor, outdoor, and city-scale scenes, T3lescope outperforms feed-forward and generative baselines, matches or surpasses per-scene optimization, and recovers fine structures as well as glossy and transparent surfaces. These results show that our method generalizes across diverse scenes, view counts, and image resolutions. Project page: https://pfnet-research.github.io/t3lescope/
2610.03308.abstract_zh: 我们从已知位姿的多视角图像重建高保真3D场景网格，无需逐场景优化，覆盖从单个物体到大型户外场景的尺度。逐场景优化方法缺少在观测稀疏、表面有光泽或透明时所需的学习型3D先验。现有生成方法利用这种先验补全稀疏观测区域的几何，但通常只能在有限空间范围内以固定分辨率运行，在覆盖范围与细节之间取舍。因此，重建大型场景常需把场景划分成分别处理且相互重叠的局部区域，难以保持全局几何一致性。为解决这些问题，我们提出 T3lescope：在推理时的由粗到细级联中，跨不同场景尺度使用同一个固定分辨率生成器。粗层级建立场景布局，细层级在越来越精细的空间单元内扰动并去噪继承自粗层级的几何，以恢复表面细节。模型在多尺度的单个单元上训练，所有层级共享权重，因此训练时不固定层次结构；层数、单元尺度和位置都在推理时决定。在室内、户外及城市尺度场景中，T3lescope 优于前馈和生成基线，达到或超过逐场景优化，并能恢复细微结构以及有光泽和透明的表面。结果表明方法可跨不同场景、视图数量和图像分辨率泛化。项目页：https://pfnet-research.github.io/t3lescope/

2610.03522.abstract_en: Feed-forward novel view synthesis has recently shown promising results from sparse posed images, but most existing methods assume that context and target views share a fixed camera family. This homogeneous-camera assumption breaks in practical multi-sensor systems, where perspective, fisheye, and panoramic cameras may coexist and where the target projection may be unseen during training. We study feed-forward NVS across heterogeneous central cameras and identify a key ambiguity introduced by tokenization: a visual token aggregates a projection-dependent bundle of pixel rays, while existing camera encodings mainly expose absolute rays or token-center relations. To address this, we combine token-center relative Camera Positional Encodings and proposed local raymaps, a token-level representation that explicitly describes the intra-patch ray distribution summarized by each token. We further propose projection-aware 2D RoPE, which replaces raw image-grid coordinates with ray-induced angular coordinates so that relative positional reasoning is aligned across camera projections. Together, these components treat diverse cameras as calibrated samplings of a shared ray space rather than separate visual domains. On ScanNet++ with heterogeneous-camera system, our method improves over camera-conditioned baselines under mixed-camera evaluation and demonstrates zero-shot generalization to panoramic views.
2610.03522.abstract_zh: 前馈式新视角合成最近在稀疏已知位姿图像上取得有希望的结果，但多数现有方法假设输入和目标视图属于固定的相机类型。这一同类相机假设在实际多传感器系统中并不成立：透视、鱼眼和全景相机可能并存，目标投影也可能在训练中从未出现。我们研究不同中心投影相机之间的前馈式新视角合成，并指出 token 化带来的关键歧义：一个视觉 token 汇集了一束依赖投影方式的像素射线，而现有相机编码主要只提供绝对射线或 token 中心之间的关系。为解决这一问题，我们结合相对于 token 中心的相机位置编码和提出的局部射线图；后者是一种 token 级表示，显式描述每个 token 所概括的图像块内部射线分布。我们进一步提出投影感知2D RoPE，用射线诱导的角度坐标替代原始图像网格坐标，使相对位置推理在不同相机投影间对齐。上述组件将不同相机视为对共享射线空间的已标定采样，而非不同视觉域。在含异构相机系统的 ScanNet++ 上，我们的方法在混合相机评估中优于相机条件基线，并展示对全景视图的零样本泛化。

2610.02784.abstract_en: Tactile sensing provides essential contact information for robotic manipulation, yet incorporating it into pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging. A common concern is that simply introducing touch during task-specific fine-tuning may fail to bridge the cross-modal gap, yielding limited gains or even reduced success. Consequently, existing methods often rely on large-scale tactile policy pretraining or separate visuotactile alignment, adding data requirements and training stages. We introduce SimpleTouch, a simple VLA extension that augments $π_{0.5}$ with a tactile expert, to test whether these additional stages are necessary. Leveraging all tokens from a frozen pretrained tactile encoder, the expert learns from action supervision and multi-horizon prediction of future tactile latents. This single-stage training uses only task demonstrations, without additional tactile policy pretraining or separate alignment. With 50 demonstrations per task, SimpleTouch achieves the highest success rate among evaluated methods on all six UniVTAC tasks. Its average success rate reaches 77.5%, compared with 45.2% for FTP-$π_{0.5}$ and 66.7% for FTP-1, corresponding to gains of 32.3 and 10.8 percentage points, respectively. Across four real-world tasks, it averages 71.3%, exceeding FTP-1 by 8.8 percentage points. These results demonstrate that, given pretrained VLA and tactile representations, additional tactile policy pretraining is not a prerequisite for strong performance on these tasks, offering a simpler route to contact-rich manipulation. Project page: https://simpletouch-robot.github.io/
2610.02784.abstract_zh: 触觉为机器人操作提供必需的接触信息，但将其纳入预训练视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型仍具有挑战。一种常见担忧是，仅在任务特定微调时加入触觉可能无法弥合跨模态差距，带来有限收益，甚至降低成功率。因此，现有方法常依赖大规模触觉策略预训练或独立的视觉触觉对齐，增加了数据需求与训练阶段。我们提出 SimpleTouch：在 π_{0.5} 上加入触觉专家的简洁 VLA 扩展，以检验这些额外阶段是否必要。专家利用冻结的预训练触觉编码器的所有 token，通过动作监督与多时域未来触觉潜变量预测进行学习。这一单阶段训练仅使用任务示范，无需额外的触觉策略预训练或单独的对齐。每项任务仅用 50 段示范，SimpleTouch 在全部六项 UniVTAC 任务中取得受评方法最高成功率；平均成功率达 77.5%，而 FTP-π_{0.5} 和 FTP-1 分别为 45.2% 和 66.7%，对应提高 32.3 和 10.8 个百分点。在四项真实任务上，平均成功率为 71.3%，高于 FTP-1 8.8 个百分点。这些结果表明，在已有预训练 VLA 和触觉表示的条件下，额外的触觉策略预训练并非在这些任务上取得良好表现的先决条件，为富接触操作提供了更简单的路线。项目页：https://simpletouch-robot.github.io/

2610.03538.abstract_en: Tactile sensing is particularly valuable for contact-rich robotic manipulation. Recent work has made substantial progress in tactile representation learning for robotic manipulation. However, similar tactile observations can arise from interaction conditions with very different task-risk implications, such as sensor noise, task-necessary variations, and emerging undesirable contact. Without context-grounded risk information, these cases can be ambiguous to downstream policies, leading to unnecessary corrections to benign variations or delayed responses to genuinely risky contact. To address this limitation, we propose Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding (RATE), which learns tactile representations that encode task-conditioned interaction risk. Specifically, history-conditioned prediction captures interaction context, while alert supervision associates this context with task-conditioned risk. The learned risk-aware representation complements conventional tactile features through a lightweight residual adapter. Experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate substantial improvements in task success, with controlled ablations confirming the complementary benefits of alert-guided learning and predictive temporal modeling.
2610.03538.abstract_zh: 触觉对富接触机器人操作尤其有价值。近期机器人操作的触觉表示学习取得了显著进展。然而，类似的触觉观测可能来自任务风险含义截然不同的交互条件，例如传感器噪声、任务所需的正常变化，以及正在出现的不良接触。缺少结合情境的风险信息时，下游策略可能难以区分这些情况，因而对无害变化进行不必要的纠正，或对真正危险的接触反应过晚。为解决这一局限，我们提出 Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding（RATE），学习编码任务条件交互风险的触觉表示。具体而言，以历史为条件的预测捕捉交互情境，警报监督则将情境与任务条件风险联系起来。学得的风险感知表示通过轻量残差适配器补充传统触觉特征。模拟与真实世界实验表明，任务成功率显著提高；受控消融证实，警报引导学习和预测式时间建模具有互补收益。

2610.03333.abstract_en: Imitation learning for contact-rich manipulation requires high-quality expert data that is expensive to obtain. This makes learning a sample-efficient policy a key issue. To address this, we propose VISTA, a workspace-level equivariant visuotactile diffusion policy for data-efficient contact-rich imitation learning. VISTA projects visual and tactile observations into spherical tokens, injects tactile contact cues into visual spherical directions through permutation-equivariant spherical fusion, and rotates the fused harmonic representation using the end-effector orientation. The resulting representation conditions an equivariant diffusion policy to predict spatially consistent actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robotic settings show that VISTA substantially improves data efficiency over strong visuotactile imitation learning baselines. Project website: https://vista-paper.github.io/
2610.03333.abstract_zh: 富接触操作的模仿学习需要高质量且获取成本高昂的专家数据，因此学习数据高效的策略是关键问题。为此，我们提出 VISTA，一种工作空间层面等变的视觉触觉扩散策略，用于数据高效的富接触模仿学习。VISTA 将视觉和触觉观测投影为球面 token，通过置换等变的球面融合把触觉接触线索注入视觉球面方向，并利用末端执行器朝向旋转融合后的谐波表示。所得表示作为等变扩散策略的条件，用以预测空间一致的动作。在模拟和真实机器人场景中的大量实验表明，VISTA 相对强视觉触觉模仿学习基线显著提高数据效率。项目网站：https://vista-paper.github.io/

2610.02338.abstract_en: A growing body of work suggests that tactile sensing gives robot policies contact information that complements vision in dexterous manipulation. However, visuo-tactile robot data remains scarce: dexterous demonstrations require teleoperating robots, which limits dataset scale. Human demonstrations are far cheaper to collect and offer a path to scale this data, but only if human and robot hands carry tactile sensors with corresponding signals. This requires sensors that conform to different hand geometries, cover the full hand, and share a common layout across embodiments. We present SoTa, a low-cost capacitive tactile skin that provides full-hand coverage on humans and robots while preserving a shared layout of 202 taxels across corresponding finger and palm regions. Our multilayer design with fabric electrodes enables in-house fabrication of thin, soft skins with customizable geometry for under $10 in materials per skin. The sensor retains over 97% of its initial response span after 10,000 loading-unloading cycles with traces retaining continuity through 1,280 tight-fist folding cycles. The shared taxel layout supports human-robot co-training with a common tactile encoder and no learned cross-sensor mapping. Across three contact-rich manipulation tasks, tactile observations improve in-distribution success over vision-only policies. With a fixed robot demonstration budget, adding human demonstrations more than doubles mean success across eight evaluation conditions, from 22.8% to 45.9%, improving success in all five out-of-distribution conditions. We plan to open-source the resources needed to fabricate and operate these skins.
2610.02338.abstract_zh: 越来越多的工作表明，在灵巧操作中，触觉为机器人策略提供与视觉互补的接触信息。然而，视觉触觉机器人数据仍然稀缺：灵巧操作示范需要遥操作机器人，限制了数据集规模。人类示范的采集成本低得多，有望扩展此类数据，但前提是人手和机器人手都配备信号对应的触觉传感器。这要求传感器适应不同的手部几何、覆盖整只手，并在不同形态之间共享布局。我们提出 SoTa，一种低成本电容式触觉皮肤，在人手和机器人手上均提供全手覆盖，并在对应手指和手掌区域保留 202 个触觉单元的共享布局。使用织物电极的多层设计使我们能够自行制作薄而软、几何可定制的触觉皮肤，每片材料成本低于 10 美元。经历 10,000 次加载—卸载循环后，传感器仍保留初始响应范围的 97% 以上；经过 1,280 次紧握拳折叠后，走线仍保持连通。共享触觉单元布局支持使用同一触觉编码器进行人—机器人共同训练，无需学习跨传感器映射。在三项富接触操作任务中，触觉观测相对纯视觉策略提高了分布内成功率。在固定机器人示范预算下，加入人类示范使八种评估条件下的平均成功率从 22.8% 升至 45.9%，增加一倍以上，并改善全部五种分布外条件下的成功率。我们计划开源制作和使用这些触觉皮肤所需的资源。

2610.02804.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often require costly real-world demonstrations to adapt to contact-rich manipulation tasks, particularly when generalization across object placements is needed. We propose SARI (Simulated Approach, Real Interaction), a phase-split sim-and-real co-training framework built on a simple insight: spatial coverage and contact physics should be acquired from the domains best suited to them. Specifically, free-space approaches require spatial diversity but tolerate modest simulation gaps, making them ideal for synthetic generation; conversely, contact interactions demand accurate physics but vary little across object placements, allowing a few real demonstrations to generalize across the workspace. SARI generates diverse simulated approaches in a photorealistic digital twin while collecting real contact interactions at only a few placements. Post-trained on these phase-segmented demonstrations, a single policy seamlessly stitches simulated approaches with real contact interactions using visual appearance alignment and a shared camera-relative action representation--without explicit phase labels or hand-coded switches. Across five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, SARI reduces real-data collection time by 34.3% and achieves 27.5% success at unseen placements, where all full-task sim-real baselines fail completely (0%).
2610.02804.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型在适配富接触操作任务时，常需要昂贵的真实世界示范，尤其是在要求泛化到不同物体摆放位置时。我们提出 SARI（Simulated Approach, Real Interaction），一种按阶段拆分的模拟与真实共同训练框架，其核心认识是：空间覆盖和接触物理应分别从最适合它们的域中获取。具体而言，自由空间接近阶段需要空间多样性，但可以容忍适度模拟误差，因此适合合成生成；相反，接触交互需要准确的物理，但随物体位置变化不大，因此少量真实示范也能泛化到整个工作空间。SARI 在逼真的数字孪生中生成多样的模拟接近轨迹，只在少数摆放位置采集真实接触交互。单一策略在这些分段示范上后训练后，利用视觉外观对齐和共享的相机相对动作表示，将模拟接近与真实接触无缝衔接，无需显式阶段标签或手工编写的切换规则。在五项真实世界富接触操作任务上，SARI 使真实数据采集时间减少 34.3%；在未见过的摆放位置上成功率达到 27.5%，而所有整任务模拟—真实基线均完全失败（0%）。

2610.02811.abstract_en: During contact-rich manipulation, interactions between a robot and its environment carry information about local geometry: a surface prevents penetration, a bore guides a peg. A controller that exploits these interactions can comply with environmental constraints while preserving task intent. Robot-earning systems commonly use position, hybrid force-position, or Cartesian impedance control. Their prescribed tracking objectives, stiffness, or force-control directions may not match local constraints and may degrade performance. We learn a proprioceptive reflex policy in simulation on three simple interaction primitives: a spring, a plane, and a rail. The policy maps task-space commands to joint-position targets using state history, without direct force or geometrical measurements. Once trained, it serves as a frozen execution layer beneath higher-level controllers. We evaluate it in dual-arm box lifting, peg insertion, and surface following. In box lifting, the reflex kept the force below the threshold while the baseline failed. In rough-surface following it stayed below the 10 N reference, on par with tuned hybrid force-position control. In 0.02 mm peg insertion It reduced mean estimated contact force to less than half that of the baseline while increasing hardware success rates from at most 22 % to 36-58 %. By separating contact response from command generation, the reflex policy provides motion planners, learned policies, and teleoperators with robust contact-rich execution.
2610.02811.abstract_zh: 在富接触操作中，机器人与环境的相互作用携带局部几何信息：表面阻止穿透，孔道引导插销。利用这些交互的控制器能够顺应环境约束，同时保留任务意图。机器人学习系统通常采用位置控制、力—位混合控制或笛卡尔阻抗控制；但其预设的跟踪目标、刚度或力控方向可能不符合局部约束，导致表现下降。我们在模拟中基于弹簧、平面和导轨三种简单交互原语学习本体感知反射策略。该策略利用状态历史将任务空间指令映射为关节位置目标，无需直接测量力或几何。训练后，它作为高层控制器下方的冻结执行层。我们在双臂搬箱、插销插入和沿表面运动中评估。在搬箱任务中，反射层使力保持在阈值以下，而基线失败。在粗糙表面跟随中，它保持在 10 N 参考值以下，与调好的力—位混合控制相当。在间隙为 0.02 毫米的插销任务中，它将平均估计接触力降至基线的一半以下，并把硬件成功率从最高 22% 提高到 36% 至 58%。通过把接触响应与指令生成分开，该反射策略可为运动规划器、学习策略和遥操人员提供稳健的富接触执行。

2610.02788.abstract_en: Transferring robotic skills from simulation to reality requires task knowledge that remains usable across differences in perception, dynamics, and embodiment. We introduce Skill2Real, an agentic policy framework that learns executable skills through a shared application programming interface (API). A Proposer-Verifier-Governor (PVG) loop uses privileged simulation evidence to diagnose outcomes and validate updates, while keeping learned skills grounded in public observations and API semantics. The Cerebellum first acquires local manipulation skills; the Brain then learns task-level composition with the Cerebellum frozen. Both memories transfer to the real robot without task-policy fine-tuning or skill-memory updates. As GPT-5.6 Sol learns skills on LIBERO-90, evaluating each frozen checkpoint with GPT-6 Astra raises LIBERO-Pro Long success from 2.0% to 56.3%, without training on Pro Long. Independent Robosuite training reaches 85.1% and 89.4% mean success with Sol and Opus 5 across seven tasks, respectively. Frozen Sol-trained LIBERO-90 skills achieve 78.75% mean completion across four real-world manipulation tasks with Astra. Removing the Verifier or Governor during LIBERO-90 training lowers final Pro Long success by 17.3 and 13.3 percentage points, respectively. These results support learning and transferring a hierarchy of executable skills through a common robot interface.
2610.02788.abstract_zh: 将机器人技能从模拟迁移到现实，需要任务知识在感知、动力学和机器人形态存在差异时仍可用。我们提出 Skill2Real，一个通过共享应用程序接口（API）学习可执行技能的智能体策略框架。Proposer-Verifier-Governor（PVG）循环利用模拟中的特权证据诊断结果并验证更新，同时使学到的技能立足于公开可见的观测和 API 语义。Cerebellum 首先获得局部操作技能；随后 Brain 在冻结 Cerebellum 的条件下学习任务层面的组合。两类记忆都直接迁移到真实机器人，无需任务策略微调或技能记忆更新。当 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 LIBERO-90 上学习技能时，使用 GPT-6 Astra 评估每个冻结检查点，使 LIBERO-Pro Long 成功率从 2.0% 提高到 56.3%，且未在 Pro Long 上训练。独立的 Robosuite 训练中，Sol 和 Opus 5 在七项任务上的平均成功率分别达到 85.1% 和 89.4%。在四项真实操作任务上，由 Sol 在 LIBERO-90 训练后冻结的技能配合 Astra，平均完成率为 78.75%。在 LIBERO-90 训练时分别移除 Verifier 或 Governor，最终 Pro Long 成功率分别下降 17.3 和 13.3 个百分点。这些结果支持通过共同机器人接口学习并迁移可执行技能层次。

2610.02368.abstract_en: Long-horizon compositional manipulation has become increasingly important for real-world robot deployment, where a single task involves multiple coordinated subtasks. Existing world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict short-horizon visual futures and actions, but typically lack explicit subtask-level reasoning. We propose Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR), a hierarchical framework that factorizes manipulation into a visual subgoal planner and a subgoal executor. Given the current observation and global instruction, the subgoal planner predicts a visual subgoal for the next subtask. The subgoal executor then jointly generates future visual trajectories and actions conditioned on the predicted subgoal. Both components share a pretrained world-model representation, enabling task-level planning and action generation to benefit from common physical knowledge. Moreover, our framework naturally supports in-context learning: using a global goal image as context can induce different subtask decompositions and behaviors without parameter updates. On the RoboTwin Clean2Random benchmark, ViGAR achieves 82.00% and 67.02% success rates under the Clean and Random settings, respectively, surpassing the strongest baseline by 12.86 percentage points in average success rate. Real-world robot experiments on five compositional and two in-context learning tasks further confirm the effectiveness of ViGAR.
2610.02368.abstract_zh: 长时域组合式操作对于真实机器人部署越来越重要，因为单项任务往往涉及多个协调的子任务。现有世界动作模型（WAM）联合预测短时域视觉未来和动作，但通常缺少显式的子任务层面推理。我们提出 Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning（ViGAR），一种把操作分解为视觉子目标规划器和子目标执行器的层次框架。给定当前观测和全局指令，子目标规划器预测下一个子任务的视觉子目标；子目标执行器则以该预测为条件，联合生成未来视觉轨迹和动作。两个组件共享预训练世界模型表示，使任务层规划和动作生成受益于共同的物理知识。此外，框架自然支持上下文学习：以全局目标图像作为上下文，无需参数更新即可引出不同的子任务分解和行为。在 RoboTwin Clean2Random 基准上，ViGAR 在 Clean 和 Random 设置下的成功率分别为 82.00% 和 67.02%，平均成功率比最强基线高 12.86 个百分点。五项组合式任务和两项上下文学习任务的真实机器人实验进一步验证了 ViGAR 的有效性。

2610.02706.abstract_en: Visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning often inherit the unnecessarily slow timing of teleoperated demonstrations. Yet uniform speedup is unreliable because different phases of a manipulation task tolerate acceleration differently. In this work, we introduce AdaTempo, a self-supervised method that accelerates visuomotor policies by exploiting shared relative-tempo structure in demonstrations. AdaTempo establishes phase correspondence, aggregates the aligned relative tempo into a consensus, and maps it to a continuous speedup profile used to resample demonstrations into accelerated training trajectories. Training standard policies such as ACT or Diffusion Policy on these resampled trajectories directly embeds the desired tempo in the learned behavior, without runtime tempo selection or online retiming. Extensive evaluations show that AdaTempo achieves up to a $3.57\times$ speedup and yields a stronger success--speed trade-off than the original policies and representative acceleration baselines.
2610.02706.abstract_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略，常会继承遥操作示范中不必要的缓慢节奏。但统一加速并不可靠，因为操作任务的不同阶段对加速的容忍度不同。我们提出 AdaTempo，一种自监督方法，利用示范中共享的相对节奏结构加速视觉运动策略。AdaTempo 建立阶段对应关系，把对齐的相对节奏汇聚为共识，再映射为连续的加速曲线，用于重新采样示范以形成加速后的训练轨迹。在这些重采样轨迹上训练 ACT 或 Diffusion Policy 等标准策略，可将目标节奏直接嵌入学到的行为，无需在运行时选择节奏或在线重新定时。大量评估显示，AdaTempo 最多实现 3.57 倍加速，并比原策略及代表性加速基线取得更好的成功率—速度权衡。

2610.03710.abstract_en: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera. EyeRobot 2.0 physically attends to a 3D fixation point in the scene by swiveling two eye viewpoints to center their gaze on it. The resulting images are processed foveally by allocating more visual tokens to the image centers, focusing computation on task-relevant features. Such Active Visual Fixation (AVF) requires carefully coordinated gaze during task execution, which we accomplish hierarchically by first training a low-level gaze servoing policy conditioned on a goal object, then training a target selector which emits fixation goals based on task progress. Both modules are trained with RL on real-world data: the first is trained with a dense geometric reward and the second co-trains with the BC gripper policy which allows it to discover fixation sequences that can resemble a human's fixation sequence while performing the task. EyeRobot 2.0 further takes advantage of fixation by canonicalizing gripper information into a fixation-relative SE(3) frame, which compacts the size of the action distribution to learn. We collect teleoperation data for 7 real-world and 6 simulated tasks, and conduct over 1000 physical and 1800 simulated robot trials comparing EyeRobot 2.0 against passive stereo and ego + wrist camera policies trained on the same data. Removing wrist cameras is costly for standard policies: with only passive stereo, real-world success drops from 52% to 27%. EyeRobot 2.0 closes this gap with only stereo, outperforming passive stereo by 40% in real and 20% in sim. It matches ego + wrist policies when their wrist views are clear (69% vs. 64%), and more than doubles their success when grasped objects occlude the wrist cameras (48% vs. 22%)
2610.03710.abstract_zh: 受人类视觉启发，我们提出一个利用主动注视、仅凭单个双目相机实现精细双臂操作的框架。EyeRobot 2.0 通过转动两个“眼睛”视角，使视线以场景中的3D注视点为中心，主动关注该点。随后以中央凹方式处理图像，为图像中心分配更多视觉 token，使计算集中在任务相关特征上。这种主动视觉注视（AVF）要求在任务执行过程中精心协调视线；我们采用层次方法，先训练以目标物体为条件的低层注视伺服策略，再训练依据任务进度输出注视目标的目标选择器。两个模块都使用真实世界数据上的强化学习训练：前者使用稠密几何奖励，后者与行为克隆夹爪策略共同训练，从而发现执行任务时可能类似人类注视序列的注视次序。EyeRobot 2.0 还利用注视点，把夹爪信息规范化到相对注视点的 SE(3) 坐标系，缩小待学习动作分布的范围。我们为 7 项真实任务和 6 项模拟任务采集遥操作数据，进行超过 1,000 次实体和 1,800 次模拟机器人试验，将 EyeRobot 2.0 与使用相同数据训练的被动双目，以及第一人称加腕部相机策略比较。对于标准策略，去掉腕部相机的代价很大：只用被动双目时，真实任务成功率从 52% 降至 27%。EyeRobot 2.0 仅用双目便弥合这一差距，相对被动双目在真实和模拟任务中分别高 40% 和 20%。当腕部视野清晰时，它与第一人称加腕部相机策略表现相当（69% 对 64%）；当抓取物遮挡腕部相机时，成功率超过后者两倍（48% 对 22%）。

2610.03278.abstract_en: As dexterous hands proliferate, collecting data and training policies separately for every morphology becomes increasingly impractical. Scalable cross-embodiment learning therefore requires a unified representation that captures shared manipulation structure while preserving morphology-specific control. Differences in hands, tasks, datasets, and control interfaces prevent existing studies from isolating the effects of representation, pretraining, and architecture. We introduce DexJoCo-X, a benchmark and toolkit for controlled comparison across seven representative dexterous hands, six single-arm and bimanual tasks, and 2,100 balanced demonstrations. DexJoCo-X provides a matched multi-hand, multi-task protocol with common scenes, success criteria, and execution interfaces, redesigned glove-to-hand mappings, and an automated pipeline that expands reviewed demonstrations across randomized scenes. Using $π_{0.5}$, Ego-Pi, and Being-H0.5, we examine whether a shared action interface is sufficient for multi-hand learning. Expanding $π_{0.5}$ to an 80-dimensional bimanual output yields near-zero success. Ego-Pi preserves the pretrained action head through interleaved prediction and supports per-hand multi-task learning, but remains ineffective for seven-hand joint training. By contrast, Being-H0.5 combines cross-embodiment pretraining, a unified action space, and embodiment-aware experts, enabling one policy to control all seven hands. Within this architecture, function-aligned action slots achieve 47.7% mean success, compared with 47.0% for native coordinates and 33.1% for DexLatent. These results show that cross-embodiment representation depends on the entire learning system: action coordinates, pretraining, and architecture must jointly separate shared manipulation structure from embodiment-specific control.
2610.03278.abstract_zh: 随着灵巧手种类增多，为每一种形态分别采集数据和训练策略越来越不现实。因此，可扩展的跨形态学习需要一种统一表示，既捕捉共享的操作结构，又保留特定形态的控制。手、任务、数据集和控制接口的差异，使现有研究难以分离表示、预训练和架构各自的影响。我们提出 DexJoCo-X，一个用于受控比较的基准与工具包，涵盖七种代表性灵巧手、六项单臂和双臂任务，以及 2,100 段平衡示范。DexJoCo-X 提供多手、多任务的匹配协议，包括共同场景、成功标准和执行接口，重新设计的手套到机器人手映射，以及将审核后的示范扩展至随机场景的自动化流程。我们使用 π_{0.5}、Ego-Pi 和 Being-H0.5，研究共享动作接口是否足以支持多手学习。将 π_{0.5} 扩展为 80 维双臂输出，成功率接近零。Ego-Pi 通过交错预测保留预训练动作头，支持单手多任务学习，但对七只手联合训练仍无效。相比之下，Being-H0.5 结合跨形态预训练、统一动作空间和形态感知专家，使一个策略控制全部七种手。在这一架构内，功能对齐的动作槽位平均成功率为 47.7%，原生坐标为 47.0%，DexLatent 为 33.1%。这些结果表明，跨形态表示依赖整个学习系统：动作坐标、预训练和架构必须共同把共享操作结构与形态特定控制分开。

2610.03476.abstract_en: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms $π_{0.5}$-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.
2610.03476.abstract_zh: 长时域移动操作面临执行误差累积，以及移动与机械臂控制之间的能力相互干扰等重大挑战。近期视觉—语言—动作模型虽擅长短时域任务，但缺少多阶段目标所需的层次推理。此外，现有层次智能体存在子任务映射僵化、重新规划不灵活和缺少持续学习的问题。为解决这些局限，我们提出 MobiAgent，一个把稳健部署执行与递归式策略自我改进连接起来的双循环智能体框架。部署时，内循环通过可高度组合的原子技能，将高层推理与低层控制解耦；它使用视觉语言模型进行滚动时域规划与视觉反思，动态组合技能以稳健地从错误中恢复。这些技能由共享统一 VLM 骨干的专门流匹配专家执行，在提高复用性的同时减轻能力干扰。与此同时，外循环通过自动切分和验证部署交互轨迹、对其聚类发现原子技能，并在无需人工标注的情况下持续微调技能库，推动自动化终身学习。在 RoboCasa、BEHAVIOR-1K 和真实任务上的评估表明 MobiAgent 有效：在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上超过 π_{0.5}-TA 22.5 个百分点，并能从执行失败中稳健恢复。通过自动复用数据，RoboCasa 成功率从 7.50% 提升到 27.50%，Astribot S1 从 32.5% 提升到 57.5%。

2610.03530.abstract_en: LiDAR-based quadrotor navigation in cluttered environments remains challenging under external disturbances, particularly when obstacle-aware motion generation and disturbance-rejection control are handled in separate layers. This article presents disturbance-resilient integrated planning and control (DR-IPC), which combines lightweight path guidance with nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) to directly generate angular velocity and thrust. An interconnected extended Kalman filter and nonlinear disturbance observer jointly provide filtered state estimates and reconstructed disturbances for NMPC prediction. The resulting formulation unifies nonlinear quadrotor dynamics, actuator constraints, local motion generation, and penalised safe-flight-corridor residuals without requiring a separate trajectory-optimization stage. Gazebo and MARSIM simulations, together with indoor and outdoor experiments, validate DR-IPC under wind, suspended payloads, narrow passages, ball impacts and reactive avoidance of a dynamic obstacle. In multi-goal navigation with disturbances, DR-IPC increases the number of completed missions from 1/10 to 9/10 in Gazebo and reduces the altitude RMSE from 0.34 to 0.01 m in experiments. The complete system operates onboard at 100 Hz. Supplementary videos are available on the project page https://drpp316.github.io/DR-IPC-Page/, and the source code will be released.
2610.03530.abstract_zh: 在杂乱环境中，基于 LiDAR 的四旋翼导航面对外部扰动仍有挑战，尤其当避障运动生成与抗扰控制由不同层独立处理时。本文提出抗扰一体化规划控制（DR-IPC），将轻量路径引导与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）结合，直接生成角速度和推力。相互连接的扩展卡尔曼滤波器与非线性扰动观测器，共同为 NMPC 预测提供滤波后的状态估计和重建的扰动。所得形式统一了非线性四旋翼动力学、执行器约束、局部运动生成和带惩罚的安全飞行走廊残差，无需单独的轨迹优化阶段。Gazebo 和 MARSIM 模拟，以及室内外实验，验证了 DR-IPC 在风、悬吊载荷、狭窄通道、球体撞击和动态障碍反应式避让条件下的表现。在有扰动的多目标导航中，DR-IPC 使 Gazebo 中完成任务的次数从 10 次中的 1 次升至 9 次，并把实验中的高度 RMSE 从 0.34 米降至 0.01 米。完整系统以 100 Hz 在机载端运行。补充视频见项目页 https://drpp316.github.io/DR-IPC-Page/，源代码将发布。

2610.02341.abstract_en: Safe whole-body motion is essential for deploying humanoid robots in unstructured environments. Modern humanoid control commonly separates reference specification from execution, with a planner, teleoperator, or motion generator providing a reference that a reinforcement-learning policy tracks through dynamically feasible whole-body control. Runtime safety filters, such as control barrier functions (CBFs), offer a promising approach for enforcing newly introduced constraints via interventions on the tracker's outputs. We show, however, that treating the tracking policy and safety filter independently induces fundamental mismatches, as filtering alters both the executed actions and the induced state distribution. We study this policy-filter interface through case studies that isolate dynamics, objective, and information mismatches, highlight their root causes, and use these insights to develop CoFiT (Constrained Filter-aware Tuning), a filter-aware fine-tuning method for pretrained trackers. Across diverse constraint scenes, CoFiT reduces violation time relative to filter-only training by 91% on TWIST2 and 21% on SONIC, while requiring smaller safety filter corrections. On Unitree G1 hardware, CoFiT reduces violation time by 83% for TWIST2 and completes every trial without operator intervention, whereas 50% of baseline trials require an operator stop. Together, these results provide actionable insights into policy-filter interactions and establish design principles for integrating learned trackers with runtime safety filters.
2610.02341.abstract_zh: 安全的全身运动是在人形机器人非结构化环境中部署的关键。现代人形控制通常将参考动作指定与执行分开：规划器、遥操人员或运动生成器给出参考动作，再由强化学习策略通过动力学可行的全身控制进行跟踪。控制障碍函数（CBF）等运行时安全过滤器，有望通过干预跟踪器的输出来强制执行新加入的约束。然而，我们表明将跟踪策略和安全过滤器独立处理会产生根本性失配，因为过滤同时改变执行动作和由此诱导的状态分布。我们通过分别隔离动力学、目标和信息失配的案例，研究这一策略—过滤器接口，突出其根源，并据此提出 CoFiT（Constrained Filter-aware Tuning），一种面向预训练跟踪器的过滤器感知微调方法。在多种约束场景中，相对仅用过滤器训练，CoFiT 在 TWIST2 和 SONIC 上分别使违反约束的时长减少 91% 和 21%，同时需要更小的安全过滤修正。在 Unitree G1 实体设备上，CoFiT 使 TWIST2 的违规时长减少 83%，且所有试验均无需操作员干预完成；基线有 50% 的试验需要操作员停止。这些结果为策略与过滤器的相互作用提供可操作见解，并确立将学习型跟踪器与运行时安全过滤器集成的设计原则。

2610.03388.abstract_en: Video is an abundant, inexpensive source of human motion data that is rich in extreme athletic behaviors. Making it usable for humanoid robots, however, is not a matter of simply retargeting a reconstructed trajectory: video-derived motion is physically inconsistent, devoid of actuation information, and says nothing about failure or recovery. We present KungfuAthleteBot (KAB), a framework that treats learning high-dynamic motion from video as the central problem and resolves each of these three failure modes in turn. (C1) We build the KungfuAthlete dataset from videos of national-level martial artists and introduce a physics-guided parabolic trajectory correction that removes height floating, ground penetration, and high-frequency jitter from reconstructed aerial and landing phases. (C2) Because video carries no force information, strict tracking of a reconstructed trajectory is dynamically infeasible, and error-driven initialization keeps re-launching the policy from infeasible aerial poses. We introduce physics-driven pseudo-low-kinetic-energy (LKE) sampling, our central mechanism for making such references learnable: it biases initialization towards dynamically feasible states, letting the policy discover feasible actuation patterns instead of imitating infeasible ones. (C3) Finally, we introduce a direct training paradigm in which disturbance rejection and fall recovery are learned inside the same policy that tracks the video motion, requiring no recovery reference data and no manual mode switching. On a humanoid robot, KAB learns dynamic skills from video and recovers from arbitrary falls in about 0.7 s, the fastest reported recovery for a unified policy. Ablations on the unified policy confirm the necessity of its components, supporting the view that repairing and compensating video data, rather than only collecting more of it, is what unlocks high-dynamic humanoid skills.
2610.03388.abstract_zh: 视频是数量丰富、成本低廉的人类运动数据来源，包含极端运动行为。然而，要将其用于人形机器人，绝非只需把重建轨迹重新映射到机器人：视频运动在物理上可能不一致，不含驱动信息，也不能说明失败与恢复。我们提出 KungfuAthleteBot（KAB），将从视频学习高动态运动作为核心问题，并依次解决这三种失败模式。（C1）我们从国家级武术运动员视频构建 KungfuAthlete 数据集，并提出物理引导的抛物线轨迹修正，消除重建腾空和落地阶段的高度漂浮、地面穿透与高频抖动。（C2）由于视频不含力信息，严格跟踪重建轨迹在动力学上不可行，而以误差驱动的初始化会反复让策略从不可行的腾空姿态起步。我们提出物理驱动的伪低动能（LKE）采样，这是让此类参考运动可学习的核心机制：它使初始化偏向动力学可行状态，让策略发现可行的驱动方式，而非模仿不可行的动作。（C3）最后，我们提出直接训练范式，在跟踪视频动作的同一策略内学习抗扰和跌倒恢复，无需恢复参考数据或手工模式切换。在人形机器人上，KAB 从视频学到动态技能，并能在约 0.7 秒内从任意跌倒状态恢复，论文称这是统一策略已报告的最快恢复。统一策略的消融验证各组件的必要性，支持这样的观点：修复与补偿视频数据，而不只是采集更多数据，才是释放高动态人形技能的关键。

2610.03616.abstract_en: We present a generalized implementation of Look-Back and Look-Ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Control (LLA-MPC), a learning-free framework for real-time, rapid adaptive system identification and control. The original formulation was demonstrated only in simulation, for autonomous racing with a fixed model structure. Our implementation has modular dynamics and integrators, and we validate it on the F1TENTH platform under constrained computation and noisy state estimation. The system identifies tire parameters online by evaluating thousands of candidate models in real time on an embedded computer. Experiments with low-friction tires across changing surfaces show that LLA-MPC completes high-speed tracking tasks where a fixed nominal model fails. Code, videos, and our related work are available at: https://lla-control.github.io.
2610.03616.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Look-Back and Look-Ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Control（LLA-MPC）的通用实现，这是一种无需学习、用于实时快速自适应系统辨识和控制的框架。原始方案仅在固定模型结构的自动赛车模拟中得到展示。我们的实现包含模块化动力学与积分器，并在算力受限、状态估计有噪声的 F1TENTH 平台上验证。系统在嵌入式计算机上实时评估数千个候选模型，在线辨识轮胎参数。针对跨变化路面的低摩擦轮胎实验表明，LLA-MPC 能完成固定标称模型失败的高速跟踪任务。代码、视频和相关工作见：https://lla-control.github.io。

2610.03391.abstract_en: World action models integrate future visual dynamics with robot action prediction, but their scalability remains limited by the need for action-annotated robot trajectories. Observation-only videos contain rich evidence about interaction dynamics, but existing approaches typically use them either to pretrain visual representations that must later be adapted for control, or to infer latent actions that are subsequently grounded to robot commands. We present NAVA-WAM, which introduces native action-prior learning by directly pretraining the action policy from observation-only videos, avoiding indirect representation-to-control transfer or a separate latent-action model. Our training consists of two stages. First, we pretrain on observation-only videos, where future-video flow-matching supervision over visual transitions is propagated through transition-structured joint attention to optimize the Action-DiT and learn action-relevant priors. Second, we use action-labeled demonstrations to post-train the Action-DiT for robot control through joint video--action flow matching, while asymmetric attention decouples the visual branch from iterative action denoising and enables efficient action-only inference. Extensive experiments show that NAVA-WAM consistently outperforms prior approaches under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, while demonstrating strong action-label efficiency and effective real-robot generalization. These results establish native action-prior learning as an effective approach to directly pretrain action policies from observation-only videos, providing a scalable path beyond action-labeled robot data.
2610.03391.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型将未来视觉动力学与机器人动作预测结合，但其可扩展性仍受限于对带动作标注的机器人轨迹的需求。只有观测、没有动作标签的视频含有丰富的交互动力学证据，但现有方法通常用它们预训练之后还需适配到控制的视觉表示，或推断潜在动作、再将其落地为机器人指令。我们提出 NAVA-WAM：通过仅观测视频直接预训练动作策略，引入原生动作先验学习，避免间接的表示到控制迁移或单独的潜在动作模型。训练分两阶段。首先，在仅观测视频上预训练；对未来视频视觉转变的流匹配监督，经由转变结构化联合注意力传递，以优化 Action-DiT 并学到动作相关先验。其次，使用带动作标签的示范，通过视频—动作联合流匹配对 Action-DiT 进行机器人控制后训练；非对称注意力将视觉分支与迭代式动作去噪解耦，实现高效的仅动作推理。大量实验表明，NAVA-WAM 在分布内和分布外设置中均持续优于以往方法，同时展现较高的动作标签利用效率和有效的真实机器人泛化。结果表明，原生动作先验学习可有效地从仅观测视频直接预训练动作策略，为减少对带动作标注机器人数据的依赖提供可扩展路径。

2610.02759.abstract_en: Generative robot policies predict short action chunks but lack explicit long-horizon intent. Recent methods expose longer-horizon structure through language plans, subgoal images, or video forecasts, which are costly to generate and still need to be translated into robot motion. Predicting future robot motions avoids this translation, but a dense, time-indexed trajectory requires numerous parameters to cover the full remaining task, and over a short horizon it largely repeats the action chunk and adds little guidance for action generation. We propose Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM), which jointly generate a compact, timing-free sketch of the robot's remaining joint-space path and a dense executable action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. The sketch parameterizes the path by arc length rather than time, capturing geometric intent invariant to execution timing. Block-causal attention and a staggered denoising schedule maintain directed sketch-to-action dependence, ensuring the action tokens condition on a progressively cleaner sketch throughout sampling. In simulation, PAM improves over its action-only counterparts on Push-T and LIBERO-Long; on four real-world bimanual tasks, it raises success from 47.5% to 75.0%. Project page: https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/
2610.02759.abstract_zh: 生成式机器人策略预测较短的动作片段，却缺少显式的长时域意图。近期方法通过语言规划、子目标图像或视频预测暴露长时域结构，但生成成本高，而且仍需转化为机器人运动。直接预测机器人未来运动可省去这一步，但稠密且按时间索引的轨迹需要大量参数才能覆盖剩余任务；若时域较短，它又大体重复动作片段，几乎不给动作生成提供额外指导。我们提出 Proprioceptive Action Models（PAM），在单一 Transformer 去噪器中联合生成机器人剩余关节空间路径的紧凑、无时间标记草图，以及可执行的稠密动作片段。草图用弧长而非时间对路径参数化，捕捉不随执行时序变化的几何意图。块因果注意力和错开的去噪时间表保持草图到动作的定向依赖，保证采样过程中动作 token 始终以逐渐变清晰的草图为条件。在模拟中，PAM 在 Push-T 和 LIBERO-Long 上优于仅预测动作的对应方法；在四项真实双臂任务上，成功率从 47.5% 提高到 75.0%。项目页：https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/
